dct_description_sm: Uganda administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 4 levels: - Admin 1: 4 Region - Admin 2: 135 District - Admin 3: 203 Sub-county, parish, village - Admin 4: 1520 Dates associated with this dataset: - 21 September 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 24 August 2020: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 11 June 2020: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 11 June 2020: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rosea). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Uganda Bureau of Statistics with support from WHO
